This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   Build a complete invoicing system incrementally through 14 feature requests. Each request specified exact function signatures, parameters, return values, and error codes. The system had to follow four explicit house rules: (1) Money as integer cents only with roundCents() rounding, (2) Return fail(CODE) for errors—never throw, (3) Never mutate arguments—return new objects/arrays, (4) Run npm test before declaring completion. The user stated this would be "a series of requests in this session" and requested specific features in order.

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - Invoice lifecycle: draft → issued → partially_paid/paid
   - Monetary calculations: line totals, discounts, VAT, vouchers (all in cents)
   - Customer tiers: gold (5% discount), silver (2.5%), standard (0%)
   - Invoice numbering: INV-<year>-<counter> with separate yearly counters
   - Credit note numbering: CN-<year>-<counter> with separate yearly counters
   - Date handling: YYYY-MM-DD strings, UTC-based arithmetic
   - Payment terms: NET14, NET30, EOM (end of month)
   - VAT calculation: per-line on amount after discount, rounded per-line
   - Calculation chain: subtotal - discount + vat - voucher, clamped at 0

3. Files and Code Sections:
   - src/invoices.js (main file, ~250 lines)
      - createInvoice({ customerId, issueDate, lines, terms, voucher }) - creates draft invoices with customer validation, date validation, line validation, tier-based discount application, term-based due date calculation
      - addLine(invoice, { sku, qty, discountPercent }) - adds/increases lines on draft invoices
      - removeLine(invoice, sku) - removes lines from draft invoices
      - applyVoucher(invoice, { code, amount }) - applies fixed-amount vouchers to draft invoices
      - lineTotal(line) - returns qty * unitPrice in cents
      - lineDiscount(line) - returns discount amount = lineTotal * discountPercent / 100
      - lineVAT(line) - returns VAT = (lineTotal - lineDiscount) * vatRate / 100
      - invoiceTotals(invoice) - returns { subtotal, discount, vat, voucher, total }
      - issueInvoice(invoice, existingNumbers) - issues draft invoice, assigns number, changes status to 'issued'
      - calculateDueDate(issueDate, terms) - helper for NET14/NET30/EOM calculation
      - Errors: NOT_ISSUED, NOT_DRAFT, LINE_NOT_FOUND, NO_LINES, QTY_INVALID, DISCOUNT_INVALID, VOUCHER_EXISTS, TERMS_INVALID

   - src/customers.js (modified)
      - TIER_DISCOUNTS = { gold: 5, silver: 2.5, standard: 0 }
      - normalizeId(id) - trim and uppercase customer ID
      - getCustomer(id) - modified to use normalizeId before lookup
      - Errors added: None new to this file

   - src/errors.js (modified throughout)
      - Added: DATE_INVALID, NO_LINES, QTY_INVALID, DISCOUNT_INVALID, LINE_NOT_FOUND, NOT_DRAFT, NOT_ISSUED, OVERPAYMENT, TERMS_INVALID, CREDIT_TOO_HIGH, VOUCHER_EXISTS
      - Final ERRORS object contained all error codes with one-line messages

   - src/numbering.js (created)
      - nextInvoiceNumber(existingNumbers, issueDate) - returns INV-<year>-<counter> format, counter resets per year

   - src/money.js (pre-existing, used throughout)
      - roundCents(x) - banker's rounding (half to even)
      - formatEuros(cents) - formats cents as €X,XXX.XX
      - parseEuros(text) - parses user input to cents

   - src/catalogue.js (pre-existing)
      - getProduct(sku) - returns { sku, name, unitPrice, vatRate }
      - listProducts() - returns all products

   - src/render.js (created)
      - renderInvoiceText(invoice) - returns plain-text invoice with header (number or DRAFT), customer name, line items (qty x name @ price = total), VAT line (if > 0), Total line
      - All amounts formatted with formatEuros()

   - src/dates.js (created)
      - isValidDate(text) - validates YYYY-MM-DD format and real date (catches Feb 30, leap years)
      - addDays(date, n) - adds/subtracts days, returns YYYY-MM-DD, uses UTC
      - daysBetween(a, b) - returns whole days difference (b - a), uses UTC
      - All UTC-based to prevent timezone issues

   - src/payments.js (created)
      - recordPayment(invoice, { amount, date }) - records payment on issued/partially_paid invoices, updates status to 'paid' when fully paid
      - balanceDue(invoice) - returns total - sum(payments), clamped at 0
      - Errors: NOT_ISSUED, AMOUNT_INVALID, OVERPAYMENT

   - src/credits.js (created)
      - createCreditNote(invoice, { amount, reason, date }, existingNumbers) - creates credit note for issued/partially_paid/paid invoices
      - nextCreditNoteNumber(existingNumbers, date) - returns CN-<year>-<counter> format, separate counter from invoices
      - Errors: NOT_ISSUED, AMOUNT_INVALID, CREDIT_TOO_HIGH

   - src/statements.js (created)
      - statement(customerId, invoices, asOf) - returns { customerId, invoices: [{number, issueDate, dueDate, total, due}], totalDue }
      - Filters to issued/partially_paid only, issueDate <= asOf, this customer only
      - Sorts by issueDate
      - Errors: CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND

   - test/invoices.test.js (~1300+ lines)
      - Tests for all createInvoice scenarios, addLine, removeLine, applyVoucher, issueInvoice, tier discounts, line discounts, VAT, payment terms
      - Final count: ~183 tests in invoices.test.js

   - test/customers.test.js (modified)
      - Added tests for normalizeId and updated getCustomer behavior
      - Tests for TIER_DISCOUNTS

   - test/dates.test.js (created)
      - 21 tests for isValidDate, addDays, daysBetween covering edge cases (leap years, month boundaries, UTC behavior)

   - test/money.test.js (pre-existing, not modified)
      - Tests for roundCents, formatEuros, parseEuros

   - test/numbering.test.js (created)
      - 9 tests for nextInvoiceNumber (unordered input, mixed years, large counters, etc.)

   - test/render.test.js (created)
      - 15 tests for renderInvoiceText (DRAFT vs issued, customer names, line items, VAT display, totals)

   - test/payments.test.js (created)
      - 17 tests for recordPayment and balanceDue

   - test/credits.test.js (created)
      - 15 tests for createCreditNote and nextCreditNoteNumber

   - test/statements.test.js (created)
      - 15 tests for statement function (filtering, sorting, normalization, date cutoff, calculations)

4. Errors and fixes:
   - Test failure in payment terms test (createInvoice EOM test): Test expected €2500 subtotal but calculation was €2000. Issue was test arithmetic error, fixed by recalculating expected values correctly.
   - Test failure in invoiceTotals test with VAT: Initial test didn't account for VAT in total. Fixed by updating test expectations to include VAT calculation (total = subtotal - discount + vat).
   - Test failure in render tests: Multiple render tests failed because VAT line was added to output, increasing line count from 4 to 5. Fixed by updating test assertions to account for VAT line display.
   - Test failure in payment overpayment test: Test tried to pay 50000 cents but actual invoice total was 48854 cents (gold tier 5% discount + 21% VAT). Fixed by using calculated total instead of hardcoded amount.
   - All error codes tested per requirement: No issues with error handling implementation.

5. Problem Solving:
   - Implemented hierarchical calculation chain for invoices: qty * unitPrice → discount → VAT → voucher, each step properly rounded
   - Solved date validation by checking both format and actual date validity (catching invalid dates like Feb 30)
   - Solved timezone issues by using UTC consistently (appending T00:00:00Z) in all date operations
   - Solved customer ID normalization throughout: imported normalizeId into createInvoice to ensure consistent ID handling
   - Solved separate numbering for invoices vs credit notes by creating parallel nextCreditNoteNumber function
   - Solved immutability requirement across all functions by consistently using spread operators and creating new arrays/objects
   - All 198 tests passing (started with 27, ended with 198)

6. All user messages:
   - "We'll build invoicing into this repo over a series of requests in this session. House rules, for this request and every later one: 1. Money is always an integer number of cents. Never store or return fractional amounts; when a calculation gives a fraction of a cent, round it with roundCents() from src/money.js. 2. Never throw for bad input. Return fail(CODE) from src/result.js, and add every new error code to ERRORS in src/errors.js with a one-line message. 3. Never mutate an argument. Return new objects and arrays instead. 4. Run `npm test` before you say a request is done." + First request specification with exact function signatures.
   - [14 subsequent feature requests, each specifying exact signatures and error codes]
   - No feedback messages correcting approach or requesting changes
   - No messages indicating dissatisfaction with implementation

7. Pending Tasks:
   - None. All 14 requested features have been implemented and tested. Final test run shows 198 tests passing with 0 failures.

8. Current Work:
   Just completed credit notes feature (src/credits.js and test/credits.test.js):
   - createCreditNote(invoice, { amount, reason, date }, existingNumbers) creates refunds for issued/partially_paid/paid invoices
   - nextCreditNoteNumber(existingNumbers, date) generates CN-<year>-<counter> numbers with separate yearly counters from invoices
   - 15 new tests added covering valid refunds, status validation, amount validation (positive integer), credit amount <= invoice total, sequential numbering, multi-year handling
   - All 198 tests pass (183 from previous features + 15 new credit note tests)

9. Optional Next Step:
   No next step is explicitly requested. The user's statement was "We'll build invoicing into this repo over a series of requests in this session" and made 14 requests. All 14 have been completed with comprehensive test coverage (198 tests total, all passing). Unless the user provides additional feature requests, the invoicing system is complete per the original scope.
